name: smwmusic-pok-mon-trading-card-game-grand-master-duel-re-arranged
title: Pokémon Trading Card Game - Grand Master Duel (re-arranged)
description:
A serious, oriental shrine-esque song that can go in final levels. The heaviness and solemness of it all builds as time goes, adding layers of echo. The samples from Trials of Mana proved very useful.

Sample @7 (Bonus End Fanfare) has been omitted.

Arrangement courtesy of Musescore user Eldina1097... Which I really want to thank since this game's OST is not among the most covered.
